title: Failed SSH process startup releases admission before sibling stream allocation and socket closure finish
cause: Promise.all rejects before sibling connectStream calls settle, and sockets were retained only from its successful aggregate. Remote termination sets quiescent while startup remains active. Failed-start streamsClosed falsely resolves and provider disposal does not join physical stream closure.
implementation: Retain each authenticated socket immediately; cancel and join all sibling attempts, then destroy and observe every allocated socket before rejecting startup. Successful observation requires settled startup as well as a confirmed remote range. Provider disposal joins physical stream closure for successful and failed handles. Bounded observations and retained independent termination failures preserve their existing reporting paths.
